assertions.name: covariance_epic_A2_pointwise_reduction_falsified
assertions.source: pointwise Cov_Planch(H_s,omega3)<=0 for-all-s FALSE for n>=29 (exact, first fail n=29, max_s=+0.056); R>=0 on (0,1) FALSE (root at n=30). Kernel cov(k)<=0 and A2 Cov(ln f,omega3)<=0 both SURVIVE exactly k,n<=40. Route eliminated with exact counterexample; kernel and A2 intact. No fit; no c_k.

description: CORRECTION (qou-x631, qou-ogrk): the A2 pointwise reduction Cov_Planch(H_s,ω₃)≤0 ∀s>0 (⟺ R≥0 on (0,1), P(x)=Σν_v x^v=x(x−1)R(x)) is FALSE for n≥29 — verified exactly, first failure n=29 (max_s Cov=+0.056 at s≈0.52, growing with n; R gains a root in (0,1) at n=30). It was verified only to n≤13 (hook-reduction audit) / n≤15 (polynomial-positivity PR #4242); the pointwise sign is a SMALL-n ARTIFACT, so the polynomial-positivity target cannot prove A2. Retracts the 'R>0 on [0,∞)' general-reduction framing of #4242. WHAT SURVIVES (exact, k,n≤40): the KERNEL conjecture cov(k)=Σ(f^λ)³ω₃≤0 (strongly negative) AND the A2 leg Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)=−Σ ln(v)ν_v≤0 — both intact. A2 survives by CANCELLATION: the Frullani identity Cov(ln f,ω₃)=∫(1/s)Cov(H_s,ω₃)ds stays ≤0 though the integrand goes positive on part of the range (n≥29). So 'A2 ⟸ Cov(H_s,ω₃)≤0 ∀s' is a valid implication with a FALSE premise; proving A2 needs the full signed integral, not a pointwise sign. Honest retraction of a small-n over-generalization (scope-(a) route-death with exact counterexample); not a refutation of the kernel or A2. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.a2_mechanism: Frullani integral <=0 by cancellation; integrand Cov(H_s,omega3) positive on part of range for n>=29
data.retracts: PR #4242 'R>0 on [0,inf)' general-reduction framing; hook-reduction 'Cov(H_s)<0 strictly interior'
